newsitem.title: USA: Perkin-Elmer March 31 Q3 earnings summary.
newsitem.headline: Perkin-Elmer March 31 Q3 earnings summary.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Full company name is Perkin-Elmer Corp.
The company reported a loss in the third quarter of fiscal 1996 after recording a charge for restructuring its Analytical Instruments Division.
Special items in fiscal 1997, in addition to the acquired research and development charge in the third quarter, included gains on the sale of equity investments in the first two quarters.
Including these items, third quarter operating income increased to $19.7 million, net income rose to $10.4 million, and earnings per share rose to $0.23.
Special restructuring charges for the same period the previous year brought the per share figure to a loss of $0.84.
Before the special items, third-quarter share profit was $0.80 compared to $0.60.
A currency translation reduced the current year third-quarter's earnings by $0.12 a share.
